summary: Tested 7 features (A–G) using the backend API (pytest, 20 tests) and the UI (Playwright). Working: A (the AI triage result scrolls into view at 1920x800 and 390x844), B (bulk auto-find stops and shows a banner with no error; CSV import starts a background backfill), C (equipment Type pencil edit: save, cancel, persists after reload, original type restored), D for the listed endpoints, E (Pulse invoice-style PDF with the speed/incline calibration section), F for the normal case, and G (MOD Operations pills computed-style identical to Staff Portal pills). Problems found: (1) HIGH: 8 other staffing endpoints still leak Site B staff to the Site-A manager. (2) MEDIUM: the PPM print report leaves out unserviced machines when a visit has no machine_work. (3) Minor UX issues with bulk auto-find.

critical.issue: The Site-A manager (manager@isodemo.com) gets 200 with full HR data, the employee-file PDF and module access for the Site B staff member deptdemo-sales-b (Sid Sales B). These per-staff endpoints have no _visible_staff_ids / site-lock check.

These list endpoints return Site B staff (Sid Sales B) to the site-restricted manager. absence-risk also returns other-department staff (Warehouse/IT), so the department scope is not applied either. Requirement 4 (site staff only see their own site) is only partly met.

minor.issue: Items that hit no_match or error are permanently excluded from every later bulk run (auto_image_looked_up_at is set). A temporary failure such as the DuckDuckGo 202 anti-bot response seen in backend logs locks the item out, and only the per-item lookup or clearing auto-image can retry it. Suggest excluding only within the current run, or retrying after N days or when status is error.
If called by a master admin, get_organization_filter may return {}. The backfill would then cover the whole equipment collection across all orgs. Guard so it only runs for a real org filter.
Returns 200 (data is correctly filtered). test_credentials.md says Site B requests return 403 site_access_denied. Behaviour is inconsistent but not a leak.

ui_bugs.issue: Unserviced machines are only added when visits[0] has a non-empty machine_work. Reproduced with Node by evaluating the real function on the SVC-00026 data: with a visit that has no machine_work, or two visits where the first has none, 0 machines are listed and there is no 'Machines worked' table. The requirement is that every machine appears whether serviced or not. Fix: always render the machine table and append the unworked machines to the latest visit, or render a 'Not serviced' table once, independent of vi===0.

After a bulk run with no matches the button still reads 'Auto-find 8 images'. Clicking again shows 'No matches this run – Checked 0 machines'. missingImages should exclude items with auto_image_looked_up_at, or the label should say that all items were already checked.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/auth/login returning 429 (or 401 for a bad password) gives no visible error on the login page. The user sees nothing happen.

issues: Severity badge shows the raw enum 'operational_minor' and sits under the dialog close X
'AI fault code' badge is orange text on light orange, low contrast
The 'Machines on site' kit list is still at the top of the in-app PPM detail modal. It was removed from the printed report only. Check whether the user wanted it gone here too.
The Engineer box in the PPM print uses the scheduled engineer (ISO Owner). The job PDF and visit line use the actual engineer (Rehearsal Engineer). These should be consistent.
'No cover' pill is grey on grey, low contrast
Content column (~800px) is narrower than the header and pill bar container (~1000px), so widths look inconsistent

action_items: HIGH: Apply _visible_staff_ids / _site_lock_ids scoping to staffing/hr/profile/{id}, staff/{id}/employee-file, staff/{id}/module-access (return 403/404 for out-of-scope staff), and to clock/board, performance, team/module-matrix, compliance/tracker and ai/absence-risk (filter rows). Re-run TestMultiSiteOtherEndpoints.
MEDIUM: buildReportHtml should always list unworked machines ('Not serviced'), even when no visit, or not the first visit, has machine_work.
LOW: Don't permanently exclude temporary 'error' (and possibly 'no_match') items from bulk image lookup. Make the auto-find count and label reflect items already checked.
LOW: Guard schedule_image_backfill against an empty org filter.
LOW: Show the login error toast on 429/401.
critical_code_review_comments: LiteDialogs.saveType mutates the selectedEquipment prop (selectedEquipment.equipment_type = next) instead of refreshing through state or a callback. It works because the list holds the same object reference, but it is fragile. Call onEquipmentUpdated or lift the state instead.
_staff_visibility_scope treats staff with no site_ids as visible to every site-locked user. That is acceptable for unassigned staff, but seed data has several such staff.

schedule_image_backfill loop stops on total_examined==8. It relies on every item getting auto_image_looked_up_at; if update_one itself throws inside the except branch, the task dies (logged). Acceptable.

success_rate.backend: 60% (12/20 pytest; all 12 requested-scope tests pass, 8 extra site-lock leak tests fail)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (A, B, C, F happy path and G pass; F edge case fails)
